reason: The patch removes every per-request `s.Init(ctx)` guard, which was the only reader of the `initErr` that `Stop` sets (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:321,339), so handlers no longer reject requests after `Stop`. `Stop` only cancels `s.ctx` and the backend poller without closing the DB (server.go:333, pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go:119-121, 577), so writes still go through while `Watch` gets `io.EOF` from the terminated broadcaster (pkg/storage/unified/resource/broadcaster.go:131-132, 206).
